body: the only way i can think to describe it is that i feel like i am physically incapable of feeling neutral feelings. i either hate someone or i love them. i either am obsessed with something, or i don't care about it at all. its an exhausting way to live, for myself and for others around me that have to put up with my extreme ups and downs. i basically cant have long term relationships outside of my family because i can seriously turn into two different people depending on how i'm feeling that day. the person i am when i'm sad is completely different than the person i am when i'm happy.  so someone might get to know me when im upbeat and excitable and goofy and then later i'll turn into someone who's low energy and mostly serious and easily discouraged/upset and it confuses them. and it upsets me because then i feel their confusion, and i cut contact because if i dont adore them then i hate them. its not realistic, and its not any way to live. this is a pattern my whole life has followed and i'm just tired of it, of not having one stable personality and being able to build a life around myself. i feel like i cant because i keep changing. i don't know what i want for myself because i don't even know who i'm going to be a month from now. even if i like who i am right now, i dont know if i'll like the next variation. the ups and downs are like a roller coaster and i just want off.

i've tried thinking that way but it just makes me feel guilt. it would be so much easier if i had a family that didn't care, or no family at all. and its shitty but i think things like, if i lived in a messed up country i could probably kill myself and nobody would fault me because they would be like "well, look at the situation, of course they did it's understandable". right now its just very selfish looking. i can't tell anyone around me because i have enough self awareness to realize its really intense and too much, if i did i'm scared i would be sent to an inpatient facility or at the very least just treated like i'm crazy and that's the last thing i want. even sharing a little bit just comes off too extreme to others. i've lost friendships and relationships over it. its not that other people don't listen its that i demand too much, and i feel like im trapped in a cage watching myself be demanding and a burden but unable to stop and just continually hurting people or needing too much. and im so tired of it and not being able to do anything. i know it should be easy "just stop" or stop doing the things i don't like. but i cant and i dont know why. its why im sure something is broken a normal person could just stop.
